test_objective: Check that you cannot update entity attributes with invalid request body

test_cases.name: 011_04_01 Update entity attributes with invalid entity fragments
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot update an attribute if the entity fragment is invalid
test_cases.template: Update entity attributes with invalid entity fragments
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/{entityId}/attrs/{attributeId}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Update Entity Attributes and
    Query Parameter: id set to '${entity_id}' and
    Query Parameter: fragment_filename set to '${fragment_filename}' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json'
}
